name: 2026 City Budget
description: Adoption and amendment of the annual appropriation ordinance and department funding for 2026.
summary: The most contested item was the adoption of the 2026 annual appropriation ordinance package: amendments to the 2026 Budget Recommendations and text portion (SO2025-0021101) passed City Council on 2025-12-20 by a divided 30 Yea / 19 Nay vote [7], during which an amendment to raise the police superintendent's salary from $284,016 to $300,000 was discussed [4]. Subsequent 2026 appropriation amendments passed with little or no opposition, including Fund 925 amendments for grants to Public Health and Planning and Development (O2026-0023819, 50 Yea / 0 Nay on 2026-03-18) and multi-department grant appropriations of $15,745,000 discussed in committee on 2026-06-15 [5][3]. Three transfers within the Committee on Police and Fire (SO2026-0022321, SO2026-0022322, SO2026-0022323) each passed 49 Yea / 0 Nay on 2026-02-18, and a resolution calling on the Mayor to implement the 2026 budget package (R2026-0023372) was adopted 50 Yea / 0 Nay on 2026-04-15. Committee hearings on the 2026 annual appropriation began as early as 2025-11-12 [6], and amendments were routinely reported out for final Council action [1]. Still open are further 2026 transfers and ward-level appropriation amendments listed on the Committee on Budget and Government Operations agenda for 2026-10-13, including items SO2026-0028812, O2026-0028794, O2026-0028227, and O2026-0027538 [9][11].
one_line: 2026 budget adopted 30-19 on 2025-12-20; later amendments passed near-unanimously; further transfers pending October 2026.
